about.title: About Us
about.heading: Empowering Artists to Build Their Brand
about.description1: Artist Nation is an all-in-one platform designed for artists, entertainers, performers, and record labels to build a professional online presence, promote music, sell merchandise, manage events, and engage fans from one centralized platform.
about.founderBio: Carl Marshall is a technology executive, product strategist, and software engineer with more than 28 years of experience delivering innovative digital solutions across the public and private sectors. Artist Nation reflects his vision of providing creators with enterprise-quality tools that simplify technology and accelerate business growth.
